source_evidence: When a fund sells a security that has increased in price, the fund has a capital gain.
question: Misconception: I receive a capital gains distribution only when I personally sell my mutual fund shares.
answer: A capital gains distribution can result from the fund selling a security it owns at a gain. At year-end, the fund distributes its capital gains, minus any capital losses, to investors; the distribution is tied to the fund’s sales, not necessarily to your sale of fund shares.
